summary: Damora Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into indemnification agreements with directors and officers and the redomestication from Delaware to the Cayman Islands, effective July 16, 2026, as approved by stockholders on February 9, 2026. The filing is a routine corporate governance update involving standard indemnification terms and a change in jurisdiction of incorporation via a plan of conversion. There are no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation terms. No price, premium, or advisor is mentioned. This is a non-special-situation current report.
